newsitem.title: SPAIN: Earthquake shakes southern Spain, causes no damage.
newsitem.headline: Earthquake shakes southern Spain, causes no damage.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 4.1 on the Richter scale shook the southern Spanish province of Granada on Saturday, sources at the National Geographic Institute said.
No damage or injuries were reported. The earthquake struck at about 8.30 a.m. (0730 GMT) and was also felt around the southern resort of Malaga.
The epicentre was located near the village of Chimeneas in Granada province.
